reason: The substitutes part speaks right to my problem, so I'd try the free version. But on weeknights I'd cook Thai maybe two or three times a month, so the free 3 dishes probably cover me and I wouldn't pay until I'd run out.
objection: I don't trust that an AI with no reviews knows what to swap for holy basil or galangal that still tastes like what I ate in Thailand. If the substitutes come out bland, the whole point is gone.
would_change_my_mind: If my free dishes actually turned out tasting authentic using only what my normal supermarket has, I'd pay the $2.99 without thinking about it.
